title: WiNeRF: Measurement Constrained Radiance Fields for Actionable Wireless Channel Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2609.22132v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Wireless embedded systems increasingly rely on wireless channel information for decision making, yet practical platforms operate under severe constraints, including few antennas, narrow bandwidth, and sparse, noisy measurements. While neural field based approaches inspired by Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) have recently been explored for continuous wireless channel modeling, existing approaches depend on dense measurements or external priors such as known geometry, visual context, or angle-of-arrival (AoA) information, limiting their practicality in real-world deployments. We present WiNeRF, a neural field framework that learns a spatially continuous, complex-valued wireless channel representation directly from sparse channel state information (CSI) collected by commodity WiFi devices. translated_title: WiNeRF：面向可操作无线信道建模的测量约束辐射场
translated_abstract: 无线嵌入式系统日益依赖无线信道信息进行决策，然而实际平台在严苛的约束条件下运行，包括天线数量少、带宽窄、以及稀疏且含噪的测量。尽管受神经辐射场启发的基于神经场的方法最近被探索用于连续无线信道建模，但现有方法依赖于密集测量或外部先验（如已知几何结构、视觉上下文或到达角信息），限制了其在现实部署中的实用性。我们提出了WiNeRF，这是一个神经场框架，可直接从商用WiFi设备采集的稀疏信道状态信息（CSI）中学习空间连续的复值无线信道表示。WiNeRF将内在系统约束，如天线几何结构、有限空间分辨率和相位不确定性，作为归纳偏置嵌入到3（注：原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出WiNeRF神经场框架，将天线几何结构、有限空间分辨率和相位不确定性等系统内在约束作为归纳偏置，直接从商用WiFi设备的稀疏信道状态信息中学习空间连续的复值无线信道表示，无需密集测量或外部先验即可实现可操作的无线信道建模。
en_tdlr: WiNeRF is a neural field framework that embeds intrinsic system constraints—antenna geometry, limited spatial resolution, and phase uncertainty—as inductive biases, learning a spatially continuous complex-valued wireless channel representation directly from sparse CSI collected by commodity WiFi devices without requiring dense measurements or external priors.
